entities.summary: Victoria Jiménez Kasintseva is an Andorran professional tennis player. On 16 March 2026, she reached a career-high WTA singles ranking of world No. 89, the first Andorran player, female or male, to break into the top 100 in the tennis rankings in the Open Era.
